name: deck-studio
description: premium-decks: consulting-, banking-, and keynote-grade decks from a folder of analysis. Ingests xlsx/csv/docx/pdf/pptx/md into a traced fact base, builds an answer-first storyline and ghost deck for approval, and renders client-editable .pptx (slide master, native charts, finance recipes: waterfall, football field, comps, sensitivity, Harvey balls) or HTML. QA gates: storyline, number tracing, arithmetic integrity, layout, and PowerPoint render. Rules derived from a study of 131 public consulting and banking decks (95 coded, 28 held out) plus 8 banker discussion books.
